style.formality: Use the informal "sen" throughout, as Turkish mobile games do. Buttons use the plain imperative (Dağıt, Çek, Oyna).
style.gameTitles: Translate game titles: use the established Turkish name of a classic solitaire (pasyans) when there is one, translate descriptive titles, and keep proper names. The current titles are the `title` entries in content/games.json; when rules mention another game, use its Turkish title.
style.cardIndices: Keep single-letter card indices (A, K, Q, J) as they are. Translate full rank and suit words; Turkish nouns take no plural after numbers (dört As).
style.typography: Use “ ” for quotation marks. Add suffixes to numbers and names with an apostrophe (10'a, Klondike'ta).
style.markup: Keep {{placeholders}}, <tags>, line breaks and markdown (##, -, **) exactly. Word order differs from English, so move whole placeholders but never change them; avoid attaching suffixes directly to a placeholder.

terms.suit: takım (maça, kupa, karo, sinek); "renk" means only red or black
